Fed Holds Rates Steady at 3.75%–4.00% in 10–2 Vote, Two Officials Favor Hike

The Federal Reserve voted 10–2 on October 28 to maintain the federal funds rate target range at 3.75%–4.00%. The FOMC said economic activity continues to expand at a strong pace, supported by resilient domestic spending, strong productivity growth, and robust capital investment, despite elevated geopolitical uncertainty. Job growth has kept pace with labor force growth, while unemployment has changed little. Bank of Canada Raises Policy Rate by 25 Basis Points to 2.5% in First Hike in Three Years

The Bank of Canada on October 28, 2026, raised its target for the overnight rate by 25 basis points to 2.5%, the first increase since July 2023. The Bank Rate is now 2.75% and the deposit rate is 2.45%. The move aims to reduce the risk that persistently high energy prices spread to the prices of other goods and services. Governing Council said the policy rate may need to rise further, but it will proceed carefully given the uncertainties. — link

Google Unveils MPC Service to Secure Crypto and Tokenized Assets

Google is developing an MPC service to help financial institutions secure and transfer crypto and tokenized assets. Now in private preview, it is expected to launch commercially in early 2027. Google’s parent company, Alphabet, already uses the technology to secure digital assets on Ethereum and Solana, though it has not disclosed which assets. — link

Brazil’s Largest Private Bank Itaú Unibanco Becomes Country’s First to Notify Regulator of Crypto Brokerage Operations Under New Rules

Brazil’s largest private bank, Itaú Unibanco, notified the central bank of its cryptocurrency trading and custody operations on October 27, becoming the country’s first bank to do so under the new digital-asset rules. The framework allows banks already authorized by the central bank to offer crypto services through a notification process, while dedicated virtual-asset service providers must apply for operating authorization.
